How are stats calculated?

This standalone prototype uses illustrative items and formulas. It does not simulate official Minecraft MMORPG balance.

Attack = weapon attack + strength × 2. Critical chance = 5% + dexterity × 0.6 (capped at 60%). Attacks/sec = weapon speed × (1 + dexterity × 0.01). Average DPS = attack × attacks/sec × (1 + critical chance × 0.5). Health = 100 + vitality × 12 + armor health bonus. Defense = armor defense + vitality × 0.5. Damage reduction = defense / (100 + defense). Effective health = health / (1 − reduction).

Attribute budget = 30 + level × 2. Exported JSON includes selected items and calculated stats. Builds are saved only in this browser.
